title: reconciliation-service: architecture overview
body:
# reconciliation-service: architecture overview

The service imports bank statements, normalises them into statement lines and matches them against ledger entries. Mismatches are written to `recon_exceptions` and surfaced on the recon dashboard.

Components: importer, matcher, exception writer, `recon-cli` for operators.

# Postmortem: duplicate Acme credits (18 Feb 2026)

Impact: 41 payouts credited twice and reversed within 12 hours.
Root cause: Acme callback retries arrived after the 24h idempotency key expiry.
Action items: revisit idempotency TTL (owner: Aditya Sharma).

title: Runbook: Nightly settlement (settlement-batch)
body:
# Runbook: Nightly settlement

Owner: Aditya Sharma. Last reviewed 3 Feb 2026.

## Schedule
settlement-batch runs nightly at 00:00 IST from the `settlement-nightly` cron and normally finishes in 25 to 40 minutes.

## Inputs
- Acme Bank statement file, pulled by the SFTP bridge.
- Ledger day-close snapshot.

## If the job fails
1. Check the PagerDuty alert for the failing batch id.
2. Re-run: `settlement-batch run --date <YYYY-MM-DD>`.
3. Confirm payouts on the ledger dashboard.
4. If it fails twice, page the Payments on-call.

## Contacts
Acme Bank integration: Aditya Sharma.

title: payments-api: idempotency keys
body:
# payments-api: idempotency keys

Clients send an `Idempotency-Key` header on POST requests. Keys and the original response live in Redis with a 72-hour TTL. A repeated key returns the stored response with status 200 and header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

body:
# Finance reporting models

Month-end revenue is recognised on settlement date, not capture date (since April 2026 close). Models: `finance_snapshot`, `revenue_monthly`, `settlement_daily`.

title: RFC-014: Reconciliation matching strategy
body:
# RFC-014: Reconciliation matching strategy

Status: Accepted (20 May 2026). Author: Aditya Sharma. Reviewer: Vishal Rao.

## Problem
Exact amount matching between Acme statement lines and ledger entries flags about 2% of FX-converted payments as mismatches every night.

## Decision
Match on the bank reference first. Then match on amount with a tolerance of ±1 minor unit, for FX-converted payments only.

## Why
Acme rounds FX conversions half-up. Our ledger uses banker's rounding (half-even). The two disagree by at most one minor unit. Widening the tolerance for everything would hide real errors, so the tolerance applies to FX lines only.

## Rollout
Shipped in reconciliation-service behind `match_v2`, enabled 28 May.

title: api-gateway: Idempotency-Key enforcement
body:
# api-gateway: Idempotency-Key enforcement

The gateway enforces `Idempotency-Key` on POST /payments using the shared payments keystore (72h TTL). Duplicates get a 409 with the original response. Plugin owner: Swati Jain.

title: RFC-019: Ledger transactional outbox
body:
# RFC-019: Ledger transactional outbox

Status: Accepted. Tracking: LUM-412.

ledger-service writes events to an `outbox` table in the same transaction as the ledger entry. A relay publishes them with at-least-once delivery, keyed by event id. This removes the event loss during deploys that causes phantom reconciliation mismatches.

title: Runbook: reconciliation-service
body:
# Runbook: reconciliation-service

Matches Acme Bank statement lines against ledger entries every night.

## Common issues
- When it is flagging a spike of exceptions this morning: usually a late statement file; the importer retries every 15 minutes. Fix: re-run the matcher for that value date once the import is green.
- When it is slow on the morning run: usually the matcher starting before the import had finished. Fix: wait for the 07:00 retry, it clears itself.
- When it is showing duplicate exceptions for one merchant: usually a reversed payout that hasn't posted yet. Fix: mark them as timing exceptions; they auto-close on the next run.
- When it is stuck on the import step: usually an expired import credential. Fix: rotate the import credential in Vault and re-run the import.

title: settlement-batch: design notes
body:
# settlement-batch: design notes

Nightly job that settles merchant payouts and closes the day in the ledger.

## Common issues
- When it is running long tonight: usually a very large merchant batch, the run time scales with payout count. Fix: let it finish; it parallelises per merchant after the first 10 minutes.
- When it is showing fewer payouts than expected: usually a merchant flagged on hold in the payouts table. Fix: check `payout_holds` and release the hold with ops approval.
- When it is skipping one merchant: usually the day-close snapshot arriving late. Fix: look at the run summary in Grafana before touching anything.

title: acme-sftp-bridge: design notes
body:
# acme-sftp-bridge: design notes

Pulls Acme Bank statement files over SFTP and verifies Acme webhooks.

## Common issues
- When it is timing out on the morning pull: usually the remote host rotating its key. Fix: update the known_hosts entry from the bridge config repo.
- When it is rejecting a webhook signature: usually a clock skew on the callback timestamp. Fix: check the timestamp tolerance; it's 5 minutes.
- When it is pulling the same file twice: usually the done-marker file not being written on their side. Fix: the bridge dedupes by checksum, so the second pull is harmless.

title: payments-api: FAQ
body:
# payments-api: FAQ

Public API for creating, capturing and refunding payments.

## Common issues
- When it is returning 409s on refunds: usually a client reusing keys across different payloads. Fix: return the stored response and tell the client to generate a fresh key.
- When it is slow on capture since the last deploy: usually a missing index on captures by merchant. Fix: the index migration is in the next release.
- When it is rejecting a client's idempotency header: usually a header with whitespace that the validator rejects. Fix: trim the header in the client SDK.
- When it is throwing 500s on partial refunds: usually partial refunds on a payment that's still authorising. Fix: wait for capture to settle before refunding.

title: Runbook: ledger-service
body:
# Runbook: ledger-service

Double-entry ledger of every money movement.

## Common issues
- When it is showing an imbalance alert: usually a reversal posted on one side only. Fix: post the compensating entry through the admin tool, never by hand.
- When it is lagging on the event stream: usually a consumer stuck on a poison message. Fix: skip the message with the DLQ tool and file a ticket.
- When it is rejecting a journal entry: usually a currency without a configured account. Fix: add the account mapping and replay the entry.

title: Runbook: api-gateway
body:
# Runbook: api-gateway

Kong-based edge gateway: auth, rate limits, idempotency headers.

## Common issues
- When it is rate limiting a merchant too aggressively: usually the merchant sharing a key across environments. Fix: give them a separate sandbox key.
- When it is adding latency on auth: usually the JWKS cache expiring at the same time on every pod. Fix: the jitter on the JWKS refresh fixes it.
- When it is returning 502s for one route: usually an upstream health check pointing at the wrong port. Fix: fix the upstream target in the declarative config.

title: checkout-web: design notes
body:
# checkout-web: design notes

Hosted checkout pages and the card/UPI payment flow.

## Common issues
- When it is showing a blank page on old Safari: usually a polyfill missing from the legacy bundle. Fix: ship the legacy bundle flag.
- When it is dropping UPI intents on Android: usually the intent URL getting encoded twice. Fix: decode once in the redirect handler.
- When it is double-submitting the pay button: usually a slow network plus a missing disabled state. Fix: disable the button on first click and show the spinner.

title: ci-pipeline: design notes
body:
# ci-pipeline: design notes

Self-hosted Buildkite runners and deploy pipeline.

## Common issues
- When it is queueing builds for ages: usually all agents busy with nightly jobs. Fix: bump the agent pool for the day in the autoscaler.
- When it is failing on the docker login step: usually an expired registry token on the agents. Fix: rotate the registry token in the agent secrets.
- When it is running the wrong pipeline for a branch: usually a stale pipeline upload from a renamed branch. Fix: re-upload the pipeline from the branch.

Unleash-backed feature flag service.

- When it is not picking up a toggle change: usually the SDK cache refreshing every 60 seconds. Fix: wait a minute or force a refresh from the admin UI.
- When it is showing different values per pod: usually a pod pinned to an old SDK version. Fix: roll the deployment so every pod has the same SDK.

title: staging-env: design notes
body:
# staging-env: design notes

Shared staging environment and its nightly database snapshots.

## Common issues
- When it is missing yesterday's data: usually the nightly snapshot job running late. Fix: trigger the snapshot job manually.
- When it is out of disk: usually old preview environments never torn down. Fix: run the preview cleanup job.
- When it is slow to deploy: usually image pulls from the wrong registry mirror. Fix: point the namespace at the local mirror.

title: Runbook: fraud-rules
body:
# Runbook: fraud-rules

Real-time fraud rules evaluated on every card payment.

## Common issues
- When it is blocking a merchant's legit customers: usually the device fingerprint rule firing on a shared office network. Fix: add the merchant's network to the allowlist with an expiry.
- When it is scoring slower than usual: usually a rule querying a cold cache after deploy. Fix: warm the cache before routing traffic.

BigQuery warehouse fed by CDC from production databases.
